scenes.title: The verifier decodes the media—not just the filename.
scenes.visual: historical incident-room visual deliberately omitted from public source
scenes.footer: Owned H.264/AAC fixtures; frame and PCM evidence; no TikTok data.
scenes.narration: The verifier decodes video frames and PCM audio. It rejects the six-second boundary bug, rejects a same-duration wrong-scene control, and accepts only the two-second reference-equivalent cut. A separate DecodeBridge canary checks three hundred sixty hardware-decoded frames against CPU and Metal evidence.

scenes.title: One timestamp tick closes only dependent authority.
scenes.footer: A declared proof graph turns one failure into an exact blast radius.
scenes.narration: Now inject one presentation-timestamp tick. The timeline proof fails. Temporal selection and retain authority depend on it, so both lose authority. Input identity, hardware decode, and CPU-Metal parity remain digest-valid. The whole run does not restart.

scenes.title: Selective recovery executes 3 verifiers, not 6.
scenes.visual: historical causal-reflex visual deliberately omitted from public source
scenes.evidenceSummary: 3 verifier calls; 3 reused proofs; full-replay root matched; 0 stale escapes
scenes.footer: 50% is verifier-graph work in one fixture—not measured latency or energy.
scenes.narration: Reconcile invokes the three affected verifier functions and reuses three sealed proofs. A six-call reference replay computes the same evidence root. Any divergence fails closed. The result is three of six replayed, three reused, and zero stale promotion escapes.

scenes.title: A coding agent cannot manufacture its own green check.
scenes.footer: Tools are not proof. A passing receipt is not reusable authority.
scenes.narration: The runner still cannot manufacture green. One canary consumes a lease bound to the run, input, executable, source, policy, verifier, and regression. A separate process grades it. The terminal decision closes the lease, and a second consume is denied.

scenes.title: Failure becomes memory only after it earns trust.
scenes.visual: historical incident-room visual deliberately omitted from public source
scenes.footer: Origin failure → independent reproduction → exact-gate replay → retained regression.
scenes.narration: The timestamp fault becomes durable memory only after origin failure, independent reproduction, and pre-retention replay agree at the exact gate. Every later accepted canary replays it again. Failed prose and tool permissions never enter trusted memory.

scenes.title: Dynamic strategy inside a host-owned fixed reflex.
scenes.visual: historical architecture visual deliberately omitted from public source
scenes.footer: Observe → choose → propose | admit → checkpoint → verify → retain, recover, or hold.
scenes.narration: The agent owns proposals. The host owns admission, checkpoints, verification, and retention. A failed guarantee revokes its descendants; independently current proof survives. Ambiguous state becomes a visible recovery hold.

scenes.title: Three failures. Three different defenses.
scenes.footer: A counterfactual matrix also checks input, timeline, parity, and retention topology.
scenes.narration: Wrong content meets a decoded-media oracle. Broken timeline evidence triggers selective replay. Stale authority meets one-use denial. Four topology counterfactuals change the fault origin, and malformed graphs fail closed.
